channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: VinFast Structures Its Automotive Portfolio into Three Strategic Brand Lines, Unveils Two New Ultra-Luxury Models
item.description: Under this clearly defined brand structure, Lac Hong represents the pinnacle of ultra-luxury, conceived to honor national pride and currently comprising the 900 LX, 900S and 800S models.

item.title: KM4 federal flats reconstruction in Kota Kinabalu set for March 20
item.description: The RM159.79 million project to rebuild unsafe civil servant quarters in Sabah will begin construction on March 20, providing 216 new units.

item.title: Malaysia says no evacuation needed for citizens in gulf states
item.description: Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan says the situation in Gulf countries remains under control, with 29,000 Malaysians currently in the region.

item.title: Government to enhance bill drafting with public engagement
item.description: Deputy minister says phased consultations with experts and civil society will improve quality and transparency before laws are tabled.

item.title: King grants royal assent to nine new Acts of Parliament
item.description: His Majesty Sultan Ibrahim has given royal assent to nine Acts passed by Parliament, covering areas from insolvency and legal aid to social security and skills development.

item.title: 6.5-magnitude quake off Sumatra felt in northern Malaysia
item.description: A powerful 6.5-magnitude earthquake struck off North Sumatra, Indonesia, with tremors felt across northern Peninsular Malaysia, but no tsunami threat issued.

item.title: Amazon data centres hit by drones in Gulf conflict
item.description: Amazon Web Services reports direct drone strikes on UAE data centres and damage in Bahrain, disrupting Middle East cloud services amid regional conflict.

item.title: PM term limit bill shows Anwar’s reform commitment
item.description: PKR's Amirudin says PM term limit bill reflects Anwar's reform pledge, despite falling short of two-thirds majority in parliament.

item.title: Thai court issues arrest warrants for alleged US$30 million fraudster
item.description: A Thai court has issued arrest warrants for a foreign businessman and his wife accused of a major cross-border investment fraud and money laundering.

item.title: Next-gen 2027 Toyota Fortuner spotted – here’s what it could look like
item.description: The next-generation 2027 Toyota Fortuner has been spotted testing in Thailand, and while the spyshots only reveal a heavily camouflaged prototype, they give us just enough to start piecing things together. We have taken a closer look at the images and visualised what the new Fortuner could look like, using the recently revealed 2026 Toyota Hilux as a reference point.
